package myce

// Compile against each predecessor and candidate to exercise the real SQLite
// codec and maintenance with the same scenario. Only the clock is synthetic.
import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type holdingsUpgradeClock struct{ at time.Time }

func (c *holdingsUpgradeClock) Now() time.Time { return c.at }

func TestFileHoldingsUpgradeProcess(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	mode := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_MODE")
	root := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_ROOT")
	clock := &holdingsUpgradeClock{at: time.Date(2026, 10, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	afterPrune := clock.at.Add(jobRecordRetention + time.Minute)
	if mode == "verify" {
		clock.at = afterPrune.Add(DefaultFileRetention + time.Minute)
	}
	q, err := Open(filepath.Join(root, "queue.db"), filepath.Join(root, "checkpoints"), clock,
		WithFileStore(filepath.Join(root, "files"), 1<<20, true))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer q.Close()
	if err := q.ConfigureLogRetention(0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := q.ConfigureFileRetention(DefaultFileRetention); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	refs := map[string]FileRef{}
	for _, kind := range []string{"replay", "full", "claim", "pending"} {
		path := filepath.Join(root, kind)
		if mode == "seed" {
			if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("holdings-upgrade-"+kind), 0600); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		ref, err := IdentifyFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		refs[kind] = ref
	}
	spec := func(key string, files FileManifest) Spec {
		return Spec{Project: "upgrade-fixture", SubmissionKey: key, Name: key, Priority: "experiment",
			Run: RunSpec{Command: []string{"true"}}, Needs: ResourceNeeds{Platform: Platform{Any: true}}, Files: files}
	}
	find := func(key string) *submissionRecord { return q.s.Submissions[submissionDigest("upgrade-fixture", key)] }
	hasBlob := func(kind string) {
		t.Helper()
		if err := q.files.verify(ctx, refs[kind]); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s blob missing or changed: %v", kind, err)
		}
	}
	if mode == "seed" {
		api := httptest.NewServer(API{Queue: q, Token: "upgrade-fixture"}.Handler())
		defer api.Close()
		c := Client{URL: api.URL, Token: "upgrade-fixture"}
		upload := func(ctx context.Context, kind string) {
			t.Helper()
			if err := c.UploadJobInput(ctx, filepath.Join(root, kind), refs[kind]); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		finish := func(key string, files FileManifest) string {
			t.Helper()
			j, err := q.Submit(spec(key, files))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := q.update(func() error {
				j := q.touchJob(j.ID)
				now := clock.Now()
				j.State, j.FinishedAt, j.ReleaseConfirmed = "succeeded", &now, true
				return nil
			}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			return j.ID
		}
		expire := func(id string) {
			t.Helper()
			plan, err := q.PlanFileRelease(ctx, FileReleaseSelection{Project: "upgrade-fixture", Jobs: []string{id}})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if got, err := q.ApplyFileRelease(ctx, FileReleaseApply{Selection: plan.Selection, PlanID: plan.ID, AcceptExpiry: true,
				CollectionCandidates: plan.CollectionCandidates}); err != nil || got.Collection != "scheduled" {
				t.Fatal("release did not schedule collection", err)
			}
		}
		upload(ctx, "replay")
		expire(finish("replay", FileManifest{"input": refs["replay"]}))
		clock.at = afterPrune
		if err := q.pruneJobHistory(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		// Older queues also persist full keyed answers from the older history
		// removal path. Preserve that exact authoritative shape with the old
		// queue's normal update and submission encoders.
		upload(ctx, "full")
		full := finish("full", FileManifest{"input": refs["full"]})
		if err := q.update(func() error { q.deleteJob(full); return nil }); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		upload(WithFileStoreSubmission(ctx, Spec{Project: "upgrade-fixture"}), "claim")
		upload(ctx, "pending")
		expire(finish("pending", FileManifest{"own": refs["pending"], "shared": refs["full"]}))
	} else if mode != "verify" {
		t.Fatal("fixture mode must be seed or verify")
	}

	replay, full, pending := find("replay"), find("full"), find("pending")
	if replay == nil || replay.RemovedAt == nil || q.s.Jobs[replay.JobID] != nil ||
		replay.Job == nil || replay.Job.Spec.Files["input"] != refs["replay"] ||
		replay.Job.FileReclamation != nil || !q.s.RetiredJobFiles[refs["replay"].SHA256] {
		t.Fatal("fixture is missing the skeletal replay and retired digest")
	}
	if summary, err := q.expiredJobSummary(ctx, replay.JobID); err != nil || summary == nil {
		t.Fatal("fixture is missing the durable history summary", err)
	}
	if full == nil || full.RemovedAt == nil || q.s.Jobs[full.JobID] != nil || full.Job == nil ||
		!full.Job.ReleaseConfirmed || full.Job.Spec.Files["input"] != refs["full"] {
		t.Fatal("fixture is missing the full keyed answer")
	}
	if summary, err := q.expiredJobSummary(ctx, full.JobID); err != nil || summary != nil {
		t.Fatal("full keyed answer unexpectedly has a summary", err)
	}
	if pending == nil || pending.Job == nil || pending.Job.FileReclamation == nil ||
		len(pending.Job.FileReclamation.Pending) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("fixture is missing pending job reclamation")
	}
	claimHeld := func() bool {
		for _, claim := range q.s.FileInputClaims {
			if claim.File == refs["claim"] && claim.Project == "upgrade-fixture" && claim.SettledAt.IsZero() {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	if !claimHeld() {
		t.Fatal("fixture is missing the unsettled claim")
	}
	for kind := range refs {
		hasBlob(kind)
	}
	if mode == "seed" {
		t.Logf("seeded %s at %s: skeletal and full keyed answers, unsettled claim, pending exclusive and shared files", BuildVersion, BuildCommit)
		return
	}

	if err := q.Tick(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, kind := range []string{"replay", "pending"} {
		if _, err := os.Stat(q.files.blob(refs[kind])); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			t.Fatalf("first collection did not remove authorized %s blob: %v", kind, err)
		}
	}
	hasBlob("full")
	hasBlob("claim")
	if !claimHeld() {
		t.Fatal("first collection lost the unsettled claim")
	}
	if got := find("pending").Job.FileReclamation.Pending; len(got) != 1 || got[0] != refs["full"].SHA256 {
		t.Fatal("first collection did not preserve the shared file's pending custody", got)
	}
	t.Logf("candidate first collection preserved the full keyed answer and unsettled claim, reclaimed only the two authorized digests")
}
